MYFIRSTMOD-RAPID_FIRE.title: Rapid Fire
MYFIRSTMOD-RAPID_FIRE.description: When played, create an extra copy of this card in your hand. The copy keeps its cost, gains Ethereal and Exhaust, and cannot trigger Rapid Fire again.
EXHAUST.title: Exhaust
ETHEREAL.title: Ethereal
ETHEREAL.description: At end of turn, Exhaust if this is in your hand.
